054/**
055 * An object that represents criteria used to <em>select</em> {@link Bean}s according to rules used to <em>match</em>
056 * types and qualifiers.
057 *
058 * @param typeMatcher a non-{@code null} {@link TypeMatcher} used to determine whether two types {@linkplain
059 * TypeMatcher#matches(TypeMirror, TypeMirror) match}
060 *
061 * @param type a non-{@code null} {@link TypeMirror} representing the kind of {@link Bean} that should be selected
062 *
063 * @param attributes a (possibly {@code null}) {@link List} of {@link NamedAttributeMap} instances representing
064 * qualifiers, interceptor bindings, or both
065 *
066 * @author <a href="https://about.me/lairdnelson" target="_top">Laird Nelson</a>
067 *
068 * @see #selects(Collection, Collection)
069 *
070 * @see TypeMatcher
071 */
072public final record BeanSelectionCriteria(TypeMatcher typeMatcher, // not included in equality/hashcode
073                                          TypeMirror type,
074                                          List<NamedAttributeMap<?>> attributes)
075  implements Constable {
076
077
078  /*
079   * Constructors.
080   */
081
082
083  /**
084   * Creates a new {@link BeanSelectionCriteria}.
085   *
086   * @param typeMatcher a non-{@code null} {@link TypeMatcher} used to determine whether two types {@linkplain
087   * TypeMatcher#matches(TypeMirror, TypeMirror) match}
088   *
089   * @param type a non-{@code null} {@link TypeMirror} representing the kind of {@link Bean} that should be selected
090   *
091   * @exception NullPointerException if either {@code typeMatcher} or {@code type} is {@code null}
092   */
093  public BeanSelectionCriteria(final TypeMatcher typeMatcher, final TypeMirror type) {
094    this(typeMatcher, type, null);
095  }
096
097  /**
098   * Creates a new {@link BeanSelectionCriteria}.
099   *
100   * @param typeMatcher a non-{@code null} {@link TypeMatcher} used to determine whether two types {@linkplain
101   * TypeMatcher#matches(TypeMirror, TypeMirror) match}
102   *
103   * @param type a non-{@code null} {@link TypeMirror} representing the kind of {@link Bean} that should be selected
104   *
105   * @param attributes a (possibly {@code null}) {@link List} of {@link NamedAttributeMap} instances representing
106   * qualifiers, interceptor bindings, or both; if {@code null} then the return value from an invocation of the {@link
107   * Qualifiers#defaultQualifiers()} method will be used instead
108   *
109   * @exception NullPointerException if either {@code typeMatcher} or {@code type} is {@code null}
110   */
111  public BeanSelectionCriteria {
112    final TypeAndElementSource tes = typeMatcher.typeAndElementSource();
113    type = validateType(DelegatingTypeMirror.of(type, tes, new SameTypeEquality(tes)));
114    attributes = attributes == null ? defaultQualifiers() : List.copyOf(attributes);
115  }
116
117
118  /*
119   * Instance methods.
120   */
121
122
123  /**
124   * Returns an immutable sublist of this {@link BeanSelectionCriteria}'s {@linkplain #attributes() attributes} that are
125   * interceptor bindings.
126   *
127   * <p>This method never returns {@code null}.</p>
128   *
129   * <p>This method is idempotent and returns a determinate value.</p>
130   *
131   * @return an immutable sublist of this {@link BeanSelectionCriteria}'s {@linkplain #attributes() attributes} that are
132   * interceptor bindings; never {@code null}
133   *
134   * @see InterceptorBindings#interceptorBindings(Collection)
135   */
136  public final List<NamedAttributeMap<?>> interceptorBindings() {
137    return InterceptorBindings.interceptorBindings(this.attributes());
138  }
139
140  /**
141   * Returns an immutable sublist of this {@link BeanSelectionCriteria}'s {@linkplain #attributes() attributes} that are
142   * qualifiers.
143   *
144   * <p>This method never returns {@code null}.</p>
145   *
146   * <p>This method is idempotent and returns a determinate value.</p>
147   *
148   * @return an immutable sublist of this {@link BeanSelectionCriteria}'s {@linkplain #attributes() attributes} that are
149   * qualifiers; never {@code null}
150   *
151   * @see Qualifiers#qualifiers(Collection)
152   */
153  public final List<NamedAttributeMap<?>> qualifiers() {
154    return Qualifiers.qualifiers(this.attributes());
155  }
156
157  /**
158   * Returns {@code true} if an invocation of the {@link #selects(Collection, Collection)} method supplied with the
159   * supplied {@link Id}'s {@linkplain Id#types() types} and {@linkplain Id#attributes() attributes} returns {@code
160   * true}.
161   *
162   * @param id an {@link Id}; must not be {@code null}
163   *
164   * @return {@code true} if an invocation of the {@link #selects(Collection, Collection)} method supplied with the
165   * supplied {@link Id}'s {@linkplain Id#types() types} and {@linkplain Id#attributes() attributes} returns {@code
166   * true}; {@code false} in all other cases
167   *
168   * @exception NullPointerException if {@code id} is {@code null}
169   *
170   * @see #selects(Collection, Collection)
171   *
172   * @see Id#types()
173   *
174   * @see Id#attributes()
175   */
176  public final boolean selects(final Id id) {
177    return this.selects(id.types(), id.attributes());
178  }
179
180  public final boolean selects(final Bean<?> bean) {
181    return this.selects(bean.id());
182  }
183
184  public final boolean selects(final TypeMirror type) {
185    return this.selects(List.of(type));
186  }
187
188  public final boolean selects(final Collection<? extends TypeMirror> types) {
189    return this.selects(types, List.of());
190  }
191
192  public final boolean selects(final TypeMirror type, final Collection<? extends NamedAttributeMap<?>> attributes) {
193    return this.selects(List.of(type), attributes);
194  }
195
196  /**
197   * Returns {@code true} if an invocation of {@link #selectsQualifiers(Collection)} supplied with the supplied {@code
198   * attributes} returns {@code true}, and if an invocation of {@link #selectsInterceptorBindings(Collection)} supplied
199   * with the supplied {@code attributes} also returns {@code true}, and if an invocation of {@link
200   * #selectsTypeFrom(Collection)} supplied with the supplied {@code types} returns {@code true}.
201   *
202   * @param types a {@link Collection} of {@link TypeMirror} instances; must not be {@code null}
203   *
204   * @param attributes a {@link Collection} of {@link NamedAttributeMap} instances representing qualifiers, interceptor
205   * bindings or both
206   *
207   * @return {@code true} if an invocation of {@link #selectsQualifiers(Collection)} supplied with the supplied {@code
208   * attributes} returns {@code true}, and if an invocation of {@link #selectsInterceptorBindings(Collection)} supplied
209   * with the supplied {@code attributes} also returns {@code true}, and if an invocation of {@link
210   * #selectsTypeFrom(Collection)} supplied with the supplied {@code types} returns {@code true}; {@code false} in all
211   * other cases
212   *
213   * @exception NullPointerException if either {@code types} or {@code attributes} is {@code null}
214   *
215   * @see #selectsInterceptorBindings(Collection)
216   *
217   * @see #selectsQualifiers(Collection)
218   *
219   * @see #selectsTypeFrom(Collection)
220   */
221  public final boolean selects(final Collection<? extends TypeMirror> types,
222                               final Collection<? extends NamedAttributeMap<?>> attributes) {
223    return this.selectsQualifiers(attributes) && this.selectsInterceptorBindings(attributes) && this.selectsTypeFrom(types);
224  }
225
226  public final boolean selectsInterceptorBindings(final Collection<? extends NamedAttributeMap<?>> attributes) {
227    final List<? extends NamedAttributeMap<?>> herBindings = InterceptorBindings.interceptorBindings(attributes);
228    if (herBindings.isEmpty()) {
229      return this.interceptorBindings().isEmpty();
230    } else if (herBindings.size() == 1 && anyInterceptorBinding(herBindings.iterator().next())) {
231      return true;
232    }
233    final List<NamedAttributeMap<?>> ibs = this.interceptorBindings();
234    return ibs.size() == herBindings.size() && ibs.containsAll(herBindings) && herBindings.containsAll(ibs);
235  }
236
237  /**
238   * Returns {@code true} if and only if this {@link BeanSelectionCriteria}'s {@linkplain #qualifiers() qualifiers} are
239   * contained by the qualifiers present in the supplied {@link Collection} of attributes.
240   *
241   * <p>If the return value of an invocation of the {@link #qualifiers()} method is empty, then this method behaves as
242   * if the return value of an invocation of {@link Qualifiers#defaultQualifiers()} were returned instead.</p>
243   *
244   * <p>If the supplied {@code attributes} has no qualifiers, then the return value of {@link
245   * Qualifiers#anyAndDefaultQualifiers()} will be used instead.</p>
246   *
247   * @param attributes a {@link Collection} of {@link NamedAttributeMap} instances representing attributes; must not be {@code null}
248   *
249   * @return {@code true} if and only if this {@link BeanSelectionCriteria}'s {@linkplain #qualifiers() qualifiers} are
250   * contained by the qualifiers present in the supplied {@link Collection} of attributes; {@code false} in all other
251   * cases
252   *
253   * @exception NullPointerException if {@code attributes} is {@code null}
254   */
255  public final boolean selectsQualifiers(final Collection<? extends NamedAttributeMap<?>> attributes) {
256    final Collection<? extends NamedAttributeMap<?>> myQualifiers = this.qualifiers();
257    final List<? extends NamedAttributeMap<?>> herQualifiers = Qualifiers.qualifiers(attributes);
258    if (myQualifiers.isEmpty()) {
259      // Pretend I had [@Default] and she had at least [@Default] (e.g. [@Default, @Any])
260      return herQualifiers.isEmpty() || containsAll(herQualifiers::contains, defaultQualifiers());
261    } else if (herQualifiers.isEmpty()) {
262      for (final NamedAttributeMap<?> myQualifier : myQualifiers) {
263        if (anyQualifier(myQualifier) || defaultQualifier(myQualifier)) {
264          // I had [@Default] or [@Any] or [@Default, @Any]; pretend she had [@Default, @Any].
265          return true;
266        }
267      }
268      return false;
269    } else {
270      return containsAll(herQualifiers::contains, myQualifiers);
271    }
272  }
273
274  /**
275   * Returns {@code true} if and only if this {@link BeanSelectionCriteria}'s {@linkplain #type() type} {@linkplain
276   * TypeMatcher#matches(TypeMirror, TypeMirror) <em>matches</em>} at least one of the {@link TypeMirror} instances in
277   * the supplied {@link Collection} of {@link TypeMirror}s.
278   *
279   * @param types a {@link Collection} of {@link TypeMirror}s; must not be {@code null}
280   *
281   * @return {@code true} if and only if this {@link BeanSelectionCriteria}'s {@linkplain #type() type} {@linkplain
282   * TypeMatcher#matches(TypeMirror, TypeMirror) <em>matches</em>} at least one of the {@link TypeMirror} instances in
283   * the supplied {@link Collection} of {@link TypeMirror}s; {@code false} in all other cases
284   *
285   * @exception NullPointerException if {@code types} is {@code null}
286   */
287  public final boolean selectsTypeFrom(final Collection<? extends TypeMirror> types) {
288    final TypeMatcher typeMatcher = this.typeMatcher();
289    final TypeMirror receiver = this.type();
290    for (final TypeMirror payload : types) {
291      if (typeMatcher.matches(receiver, payload)) {
292        return true;
293      }
294    }
295    return false;
296  }
297
298  /**
299   * Returns an {@link Optional} containing a {@link DynamicConstantDesc} describing this {@link BeanSelectionCriteria},
300   * or an {@linkplain Optional#isEmpty() empty <code>Optional</code>} if it could not be described.
301   *
302   * @return an {@link Optional} containing a {@link DynamicConstantDesc} describing this {@link BeanSelectionCriteria},
303   * or an {@linkplain Optional#isEmpty() empty <code>Optional</code>} if it could not be describe; never {@code null}
304   */
305  @Override // Constable
306  public final Optional<DynamicConstantDesc<BeanSelectionCriteria>> describeConstable() {
307    return this.typeMatcher().describeConstable()
308      .flatMap(typeMatcherDesc -> ((DelegatingTypeMirror)this.type()).describeConstable()
309               .flatMap(typeDesc -> Constables.describeConstable(this.attributes())
310                        .map(attributesDesc -> DynamicConstantDesc.of(BSM_INVOKE,
311                                                                      MethodHandleDesc.ofMethod(STATIC,
312                                                                                                CD_BeanSelectionCriteria,
313                                                                                                "of",
314                                                                                                MethodTypeDesc.of(CD_BeanSelectionCriteria,
315                                                                                                                  CD_TypeMatcher,
316                                                                                                                  CD_TypeMirror,
317                                                                                                                  CD_Collection)),
318                                                                      typeMatcherDesc,
319                                                                      typeDesc,
320                                                                      attributesDesc))));
321  }
322
323  @Override // Object
324  public final int hashCode() {
325    int hashCode = 17;
326    hashCode = 31 * hashCode + this.type().hashCode();
327    hashCode = 31 * hashCode + this.attributes().hashCode();
328    return hashCode;
329  }
330
331  @Override // Object
332  public final boolean equals(final Object other) {
333    if (other == this) {
334      return true;
335    } else if (other != null && other.getClass() == this.getClass()) {
336      final BeanSelectionCriteria her = (BeanSelectionCriteria)other;
337      return
338        Objects.equals(this.type(), her.type()) &&
339        Objects.equals(this.attributes(), her.attributes());
340    } else {
341      return false;
342    }
343  }
344
345  @Override
346  public final String toString() {
347    return
348      this.getClass().getSimpleName() + "[" +
349      "type=" + this.type() + ", " +
350      "attributes=" + this.attributes() +
351      "]";
352  }
353
354
355  /*
356   * Static methods.
357   */
358
359
360  private static final <T extends DelegatingTypeMirror> T validateType(final T type) {
361    return switch (type.getKind()) {
362    case ARRAY, BOOLEAN, BYTE, CHAR, DECLARED, DOUBLE, FLOAT, INT, LONG, SHORT -> type;
363    case ERROR, EXECUTABLE, INTERSECTION, MODULE, NONE, NULL, OTHER, PACKAGE, TYPEVAR, UNION, VOID, WILDCARD ->
364      throw new IllegalArgumentException("type: " + type);
365    };
366  }
367
368  private static final boolean containsAll(final Predicate<? super Object> p, final Iterable<?> i) {
369    for (final Object o : i) {
370      if (!p.test(o)) {
371        return false;
372      }
373    }
374    return true;
375  }
376
377  // Called by describeConstable().
378  public static final BeanSelectionCriteria of(final TypeMatcher tm,
379                                               final TypeMirror type,
380                                               final Collection<? extends NamedAttributeMap<?>> attributes) {
381    return new BeanSelectionCriteria(tm, type, List.copyOf(attributes));
382  }
383
384}
